ok writing this on my phone so apologies for typos — Jen Marwick here from Cardinal Hill. we're a buyer's agency, only buyers, no listing work. based in Charlottesville Virginia. been doing this since 2011. five agents now, all of them buyer's agents only (we're certified ABRs).

what makes us different is the no-listings thing. most agencies do both sides of the deal — when an agent has a listing AND is showing buyers, there's a conflict of interest that nobody likes to talk about. we just don't. we represent buyers exclusively. we get paid by the seller's side at closing same as anyone, but our loyalty is to whoever's buying the house.

who hires us: people relocating into Charlottesville from out of state (UVA faculty, NGIC, NRO, a lot of DC-area expats), first time buyers in the under-400k range, and a steady stream of empty nesters downsizing from the McMansion neighborhoods in Albemarle county. we don't do investor work — flippers and short-term rental folks usually find us a bad fit because we're going to spend three hours doing a home inspection walkthrough and they want speed.

our website should make the buyer-only thing very clear. that's the whole pitch. it should also have:
- the agents (5 of us)
- the process — we have a 9-step thing we walk every client through, would be good to have on the site
- testimonials (we have 60+ google reviews, can repurpose)
- a relocation guide for people moving in from out of state (we have a 32 page PDF — could be the lead magnet)
- contact and inquiry form

voice: warm, calm, a little nerdy. we send a 30 page market report to clients every quarter. we like data. we like the long answer. we don't do hype.

pricing: zero direct cost to the buyer (buyer's agency commissions come from the seller's side at closing) so this isn't really a "premium vs budget" decision for our clients. they pick us on fit not price.

jen@cardinalhill.com or 434-555-0918. office is downtown at 200 East Main but we mostly work out of clients' kitchen tables.
